- `public CallbackTweener TweenCallback(Callable callback)` - Calls a callable when its step is reached.
- `public MethodTweener TweenMethod(Callable method, Variant from, Variant to, double duration)` - Calls a method every frame with a value interpolated from from to to.
- `public SubtweenTweener TweenSubtween(Tween subtween)` - Runs another tween as one step of this one: it plays for its own length and this tween waits for it.
- `public Tween SetParallel(bool parallel = true)` - Makes every tweener from now on run alongside the previous one (or, with false, one after the other).
- `public Tween Parallel()` - Makes only the next tweener run alongside the previous one.
- `public Tween Chain()` - Makes the next tweener start after the previous step (undoes SetParallel for one tweener).
- `public Tween SetLoops(int loops = 0)` - How many times the tween plays; 0 is forever.

- `public Tween SetEase(EaseType ease)` - The ease tweeners use unless they name their own (default InOut).

- `public Tween SetPauseMode(TweenPauseMode mode)`
- `public Tween SetIgnoreTimeScale(bool ignore = true)`
- `public Tween BindNode(Node node)` - Binds the tween to a node: it stops when the node is freed, waits while the node is out of the tree, and (by default) pauses when the node does.
- `public void Play()` - Starts or resumes the tween.
- `public void Pause()`
- `public void Stop()` - Stops the tween and rewinds it to its beginning; Play starts it again.
- `public void Kill()` - Ends the tween now; it cannot be used again.

### VehicleBody3D

`public class VehicleBody3D : RigidBody3D` - A car or truck (Godot's VehicleBody3D): a rigid body whose child VehicleWheel3D nodes hold it up and drive it.

- `public VehicleBody3D()`
- `public float EngineForce { get; set; }` - Force in newtons on every wheel that is used as traction.
- `public float Brake { get; set; }` - Braking, as an impulse per step, on every wheel.
- `public float Steering { get; set; }` - Steering angle in radians (positive to the left) on every wheel that is used for steering.
